job.name: Part-Time Nanny in Huntington Beach (NEWBORN)
job.description:
Part-Time Nanny in Huntington Beach (NEWBORN)

The baby boy's due date is September 6th.

Zip Code: 92647


Schedule: Monday - Friday 8AM - 12PM (with flexible availability from 6AM - 2PM)

Pay: $18–$20/hour base pay

Location: Huntington Beach, CA 92647

Commitment: 12+ months preferred


Hello,


Are you smart, capable, and always ready for an adventure? If so, this may be the perfect childcare opportunity for you!


At Jovie Newport Beach, we believe in the magic of childhood and are looking for caregivers who share our passion for helping children learn, grow, and thrive. If babysitting feels more like play than work and you naturally gravitate toward engaging with kids, we’d love to meet you.


For over 20 years, Jovie (formerly College Nannies + Sitters) has been a trusted childcare provider serving families across the United States. Our mission is simple: Building Stronger Families. We provide our caregivers with support, flexibility, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference in the lives of local families.


Your Role:

A warm and welcoming family is seeking a dependable, nurturing, and experienced nanny to care for their newborn son, who is due to arrive on September 6, 2026. The family is looking for someone with ample newborn care experience who is confident caring for a young baby and excited to build a long-term relationship with their family.


The family is seeking care Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM, with some flexibility for a nanny who is available between 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM. They would ideally like their nanny to begin approximately three weeks after the baby’s due date, around September 27, 2026.


Mom will be on maternity leave for the first three months of the baby’s life and will be home during the nanny’s initial months with the family. Dad will typically be working from home as well. The family is looking for someone who is comfortable working alongside parents in the home while providing attentive, hands-on care for their newborn.


This is a wonderful opportunity for an experienced newborn nanny who enjoys creating a calm, nurturing environment and supporting a family during the exciting transition into life with a new baby.


Responsibilities include:


• Providing attentive, nurturing, and developmentally appropriate care for the newborn throughout the day.

• Following the baby’s established feeding, sleeping, and care routines as they develop.

• Supporting newborn feeding routines, including bottle preparation and feeding as needed.

• Assisting with diaper changes, burping, soothing, and other day-to-day newborn care.

• Helping establish and maintain a consistent and age-appropriate nap and sleep routine.

• Providing age-appropriate tummy time, sensory experiences, reading, singing, and gentle interactive play.

• Closely observing and responding to the baby’s cues, needs, and changing schedule.

• Maintaining a clean, safe, and nurturing environment for the baby.

• Washing and sanitizing bottles, pacifiers, and other items used throughout the baby’s day.

• Keeping the baby’s nursery, play areas, and belongings clean and organized.

• Helping with the baby’s laundry and keeping clothing and supplies organized.

• Communicating with Mom and Dad regarding feedings, naps, diaper changes, activities, and daily updates.

• Supporting the parents as they establish routines and adjust to life with a newborn.

• Providing occasional flexibility within the family’s preferred availability of 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM, when needed.


What’s In It for You?


Competitive Pay: Earn $18–$20/hour as your base rate, with occasional opportunities to earn $20–$25/hour through special assignments and events. Pay is issued via biweekly direct deposit, and you’d receive a W-2.


Overtime Pay: Earn time-and-a-half for any hours worked beyond 8 hours in a single day if applicable.


Minimum Pay Protection: If you’re scheduled for a shift under four hours, you’ll still be paid for four hours. If the family cancels after 5:00 PM the night before care, you’ll receive four hours of pay.


Vetted Family: This placement is with a family we have personally met and screened. The household consists of Mom, Dad, their young son, and two wiener dogs.


Supportive Team: Our management team is available and on-call to assist with questions and concerns. We strive to create successful matches and support our nannies every step of the way.


Group Events & Additional Opportunities: Interested in earning extra income? We offer optional childcare events that pay higher rates, include travel bonuses, and provide a chance to connect with other nannies.


Benefits & Protections:

• Workers’ Compensation Coverage

• General Liability Insurance

• Accruable Sick Pay

• Late Cancellation Pay

• 401(k) Enrollment


No Upfront Costs

We invest in our caregivers by covering:

• Background checks

• CPR/First Aid certification (if needed)

• Company T-shirt and nanny bag


Referral Bonus: Earn $200 for every nanny you refer who is hired and remains with Jovie for at least 90 days.


Scheduling & Communication


Professional Tools: You’ll use the MyJovie app to view upcoming assignments/additional opportunities as well as clock in and out.


Managing Your Availability: Need a day off? We ask for notice by 4:30 PM the day before on weekdays. Weekend schedule adjustments should be communicated by 4:30 PM on Friday to avoid cancellation penalties.


Communication Style: Communication is primarily through text message. Upon hire, you’ll be added to a group chat with management and ownership. We value clear, honest, and timely communication and strive to build supportive relationships with every caregiver on our team.


Qualifications:

• Authorized to work in the United States

• At least 18 years old

• Valid U.S. driver’s license

• Reliable, insured vehicle

• CPR/First Aid certified or willing to become certified upon hire

• Willing and able to pass a background check and fingerprinting

• At least two years of infant care experience

• Must reside in Orange County or Los Angeles County

• Passionate about working with children while maintaining a professional relationship with families


Ready to Join Us?


Apply here. Feel free to reach out to management if you have any questions.


Office: (949) 301-9422

 Email: newportbeachca@jovie.com

 Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM


Check us out on TikTok and Instagram: @joviecarenewportbeach
